old_run: 20261106_rgb512_canvas_v2_seed0 remains user-paused; both STOP files preserved
objective: Original-reference picture similarity, module identity and visible edges; no geometry extraction, repairs or Q
members: Unchanged reference_workset_v5 train16k/dev2k/test2k; train/dev monitoring500; test sealed
reference_input_rule: Reference labels are supervision and the training-only corrupted denoising state. Public conditioning never contains reference geometry; generation starts entirely masked and takes public inputs only.
representation: 512x512 discrete image: background0, module i uses class i+1; direct palette display only. Target comes from original rectangle pixel-center rasterization, never reverse-engineered from RGB.
canvas: Preserve registered public canvas_v2, kappa1.5 margin0.05 including public terminal and preplaced extents; never fit by reference
architecture_description: Conditional residual U-Net, full-resolution image features, skips, module cross-attention at128/64/32 and decoder128/64, dynamic per-module pixel classifiers at512. Global pooled conditioning is auxiliary.
generation: MaskGIT-inspired16-round image denoising. Every round may correct previous generated IDs; low-confidence pixels are re-masked by cosine schedule. No DDPM/D3PM likelihood implementation claimed.
corruption: Cosine random hidden-pixel ratio, minimum0.05, plus25% fully-masked training examples
loss: Per image L=.5*J(all-masked)+.5*J(random-masked), same public problem and reference. J=equal-module masked CE + module-mean soft Dice +.2 balanced BCE of adjacent-pixel class-difference probability (directly from segmentation probabilities). CE=mean foreground classes +.25 background. No independent boundary head, RGB MSE or geometric penalties.
selection: Same .5 all-MASK J +.5 deterministic random-MASK J arithmetic mean over dev500; one strict-minimum best. LR and early stop use same total with abs min_delta1e-4. No IoU, RGB error or picture selection.

formal_proposal.initialization: fresh; do not warm-start RGB weights

necessary_learning_check.selection: same metadata rule near n=21 used by original five-case check
necessary_learning_check.evaluation: fixed all-masked reconstruction before/after, plus public-only16-round generation; no dev or test
necessary_learning_check.gate: end all-masked module-mean image IoU>=0.75 and visible recovery of colored module regions; failure does not auto-extend or start formal training
necessary_learning_check.purpose: Necessary response to actual flat-loss/gray-image failure; one bounded fit check, not a generalization claim
necessary_learning_check.paired_views: same one member: all-masked and random-masked forwards; sequential .5/.5 backward accumulation; one Adam update
necessary_learning_check.actual_result: v2.1:250 updates on the same one21-module train member; all-MASK IoU .824502 and foreground accuracy .917833; sample16 IoU .577686. Basic fitting gate passed, boundaries remain curved; no generalization claim.
